name: duchamp
description: Make landing pages, images, carousels and launch videos from Duchamp templates — your agent builds, a fresh visual judge checks, and it retries until it passes.

interface.shortDescription: Design and launch assets that pass a visual judge
interface.longDescription: Duchamp gives Codex reviewed templates for landing pages, images, carousels and launch videos. The make skill builds each asset from a template recipe, renders it, has a fresh reviewer judge the actual pixels against fixed criteria, and retries until it passes. Runs on your own Codex subscription; Duchamp never calls a model or stores your material.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch kit for this product
